resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Forest Service list gives 1941; the other three sources say only the 1940s. Recorded as the 1941 event with the decade in the note, since 1941 fits the 1940s.

notes_for_editor: Open conflicts, not resolved and not stored as facts: (1) agency: firelookout.com says Clearwater-Potlatch TPA, the county list says Clearwater Timber Protective Association, Idaho Fire Lookouts says Clearwater National Forest; the story says the sources disagree and no agency fact is set. (2) Elevation: firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts give 5577 ft; the Forest Service list gives 4550 ft. The schema has no elevation key, so neither is stored. Record coordinates 46.89895, -115.73933 match the FFLA list. Height 30.5 m is 100 feet converted. Drive_up false comes only from the hike-in label. No source says whether the land is open to visitors, and no access level is set. Staffing: none found. Confidence is medium because of the agency and elevation conflicts and because the site-today statement is a plain absence in every source.
